title: 第13章 心机深沉的宿主第14章 又胖又丑的江欲
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
沧溟曾经也每天都在希望江欲去死，但是他自认为自己没有元梵这么强大的心，居然真的敢对江欲动手。
但是现在沧溟的心境和之前有些不同了，他现在生活有了希望，江欲都说了会打赌让自己离开，他心里其实并不想要江欲在这个时候死去。
所以他想都没想就上前想要帮江欲挡住匕首。
匕首就要刺到江欲的心脏的瞬间，江欲也终于反应过来这人居然这么狠，一言不合就要动手。
她看着元梵的眼里出现了几分不耐。
都说了这么多次了，态度还这么好，居然连一次机会也不给，真是个难办的人。
半死不活的元梵拼了命的攻击对于修士的江欲其实根本没有任何的威胁，她几乎是没有犹豫的就抬手挡住了元梵的攻击。
而手上的挡着元梵的匕首的不是她的掌心，而是沧溟和她刚刚从白婉婉手里抢来为元梵续命的玉净瓶。
玉净瓶怎么说都是一个灵器，按理来说根本不会这么容易就被匕首刺碎。
可是江欲就是故意要让灵器碎掉，她暗自在手上用了灵气，让匕首在碰到瓶身的那一刻就把玉净瓶砍成了几片碎片。
碎片落在地上发出清脆的响声，里面的水落下去的瞬间就浸没在了地板上。
“这！！！！”
沧溟原本瞪大的眼睛瞬间又瞪得更大了，事情怎么会变成这样！？
他想要阻止的动作停在原地，看着僵持住的两人也不知道做什么动作了。
【宿主！！玉净瓶它碎了！！！】
【你不是要把这个给元梵的吗，怎么就这么让它碎了。】
系统也没想到两人说话说着说着居然把瓶子都打碎了，还以为江欲不是故意的。
【宿主您也别担心，只要花费一些积分是能把这个灵器恢复的，要不要……】
系统的话都还没说完，江欲就开口打断了它：“不用了，我就是故意让玉净瓶碎了的。”
【啊？】

这话让系统的脑子有些转不过来。
【可是宿主你费力的过去不就是为了抢回这个瓶子给元梵吗……】
“谁告诉你我是为了元梵去抢瓶子的，我只是想要得到系统的奖励才会去的。”
“至于元梵，我是顺道想要解决一下原身给我留的一点麻烦。”
她的眼睛盯着面前的男人，他的脸色还是一样的憔悴。
在看到自己居然亲手打碎了能够续命的灵器之后，他的脸色更加苍白了一些，看起来比之前还要惹人怜惜。
“既然我解释了这么多次也不愿意相信我，我也只好不救了。”
“热脸贴冷屁股这种事情我可不做。”
【可是……】
系统显然是想到了什么，声音里带着几分欲言又止。
【宿主这些道侣都是双修的顶好苗子，要是您能和他们打好关系的话，就可以让您更快的变强。】
【而且这个元梵真身是狐妖，之前有九条尾巴的，你和他双修体验肯定是最好的。】
但是江欲丝毫没有被系统这句话给吸引：“可是他本来就不相信我，我就算是想要帮他也做不到。”
还想要再劝说的系统听到这话沉默了，江欲说的也不是没有道理。
content_en:
Cangming used to hope that Jiang Yu would die every day, but he thought that he didn't have such a strong heart as Yuan Fan, so he actually dared to attack Jiang Yu.
But now Cangming's mood is a little different from before. He now has hope in life. Jiang Yu even said that he would make a bet to let him leave. In his heart, he actually doesn't want Jiang Yu to die at this time.
So without thinking, he stepped forward to help Jiang Yu block the dagger.
The moment the dagger was about to pierce Jiang Yu's heart, Jiang Yu finally realized that this man was so ruthless and would strike at the slightest disagreement.
She looked at Yuan Fan with a bit of impatience in her eyes.
I have said it so many times, but my attitude is so good, yet I don't even give him a chance. He is really a difficult person to deal with.
The half-dead Yuan Fan's desperate attack actually posed no threat to the monk Jiang Yu. She raised her hand to block Yuan Fan's attack without hesitation.
What was blocking Yuan Fan's dagger was not her palm, but Cang Ming and the jade purifying bottle she had just snatched from Bai Wanwan to extend Yuan Fan's life.
The jade purification bottle is a spiritual weapon after all. Logically speaking, it would not be so easily broken by a dagger.
But Jiang Yu wanted to break the spiritual weapon on purpose, so she secretly used spiritual energy on her hand, causing the dagger to chop the jade pure bottle into several pieces the moment it touched the bottle.
The fragments made a crisp sound when they fell to the ground, and the water inside was submerged on the floor the moment it fell.
"This!!!!"
Cangming's originally widened eyes widened even more in an instant. How could things become like this! ?
The movement he wanted to stop stopped in place, and he didn't know what to do when he looked at the two people who were in a stalemate.
【Host! ! The jade purification bottle is broken! ! ! 】
[Aren’t you going to give this to Yuan Fan? Why did you let it break like this? 】
The system also didn't expect that the two of them broke the bottles while talking, and thought Jiang Yu didn't do it on purpose.
[Host, don’t worry, you can restore this spiritual weapon by spending some points. Do you want to...]
Before the system finished speaking, Jiang Yu interrupted him: "No, I just broke the jade purification bottle on purpose."
【Huh? 】
These words made the system confused.
[But host, didn’t you go all the way just to snatch this bottle back and give it to Yuan Fan...]
"Who told you that I went to grab the bottle for Yuan Fan? I only went there because I wanted to get rewards from the system."
"As for Yuan Fan, I just wanted to solve some trouble that the original body left for me."
Her eyes were fixed on the man in front of her, his face was still as haggard.
After seeing that he had actually smashed the life-extending spiritual weapon with his own hands, his face became even paler, and he looked even more pitiful than before.
"Since you don't want to believe me even after I've explained it so many times, I have no choice but to give up."
"I don't do things like having a hot face against a cold butt."
【But...】
The system had obviously thought of something, and there was a hint of hesitation in his voice.
[Host and other Taoist companions are the best candidates for dual cultivation. If you can establish a good relationship with them, you can become stronger faster. 】
[And this Yuan Fan’s true form is a fox demon with nine tails before. It will definitely be the best experience for you and him to practice together. 】
But Jiang Yu was not attracted by the system's words at all: "But he doesn't believe me in the first place. Even if I want to help him, I can't."
The system, which still wanted to persuade him again, fell silent upon hearing this. What Jiang Yu said was not unreasonable.
